title: Truffle Mushroom Pasta
description: A rich and creamy pasta dish infused with the earthy aroma of black truffles, finished with a sprinkle of aged parmesan.
author: Chef Luigi
steps: Boil water and cook the fettuccine pasta ({pasta}) according to package directions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter ({butter}) over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms ({mushrooms}) and sauté until browned.
Stir in the heavy cream ({cream}) and let it simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat, drizzle with truffle oil ({truffle_oil}), and toss with the cooked pasta.
